name: H3 Plastics LLC
old_description: At H3 Plastics, we’re more than a supplier – we’re your partner. We strive to offer quality containers, real customer service, and flexibility for your needs. We make rigid packaging the easiest part of your business.
about:
H3 Plastics LLC operates from American Fork, Utah, where it was founded in 2020 amid the COVID-19 bottle shortage. The family-owned company was built on decades of experience across manufacturing, construction, and engineering, instilling a culture of speed, quality, and responsive service.

The company produces rigid plastic containers using Injection Stretch Blow Molding (both single-stage and two-stage/reheat) and Injection Blow Molding platforms. Its facility supports small to mid-sized volume programs in PET, HDPE, and PCR blends, with in-house design, tooling, and quality systems. Hot-fill PET projects can run with a minimum order of 25,000 units.

H3 serves health and nutrition, food and beverage, personal care, cosmetic, pet care, and household chemical markets. Customers include procurement and supply-chain leaders at companies such as MedTech Solutions, Specialty Foods Inc., and Personal Care Brands, who cite the firm's on-time delivery and engineering support.

The business emphasizes a family-owned, flexible approach backed by SQF and IMS certifications. Sustainability efforts include lightweighting, reusable packaging solutions, and PCR material options, while hot-fill expertise covers thermal validation and paneling resistance.
